أَبْظَرُ A man uncircumcised. (M, K.) And the fem., بَظْرَآءُ, A woman, (T, S, Msb,) or a female slave, (M, K,) having a بَظْر; (T, S, Msb;) or having a long بَظْر: (M, K:) or a woman uncircumcised: (Mgh:) pl. بُظْرٌ. (T.) يَا ٱبْنَ البَظْرَآءِ O son of the uncircumcised woman! is an expression of contumely. (Mgh.) ―
-b2- A man having what is termed a بُظَارَة in his upper lip; (S, A, Mgh;) [i. e.] having a حِثْرِمَة somewhat long; (S in art. حثرم;) having a long (T, M) and projecting (M) upper lip, with a protuberance in the middle of it. (T, M.) ―
-b3- Accord. to some, (assumed tropical:) Clamorous; long-tongued. (Mgh.) [See بِظْرِيرٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
